She Married 3.5 years ago but unfortunately, after 2nd month of her marriage, her husband cheat her and left her without giving her talaq. After one year she became a mother of a beautiful Daughter. She took her baby to him and showed him his Daughter, 1st he denied to accept that she is his daughter but after some emotional arguments between them he accepted and believed her that he will give their rights, but he didn?t do so. He escaped again and never came back. Now, her Daughter is 2.5 year Old but there is no sign of him. She don?t know, whether he is alive or dead. My Questions are: ? Is the Nikha is still valid. ? If that Woman wants to do another Marriage, how could she do as she doesn?t even know her husband address or anything about him? ? How the separation/talaq/divorce can take place? ? How would she start a new marriage life? Kindly help her by giving her a proper advice. I?ll be very thankful to you. 1794 views Q. Talaq 2886 views Q. I am from New Delhi.Married in August 2000.Two children,daughter 6 years old and son 3 years old now.Our married life was not happy.I work in Private Company and wife works in Govt.job. Due to differences between me and my wife,on 12th July,2008,left home,took a flat on rent, called her parents from U.P. and started living seperately.All efforts for reconcilation failed.She had even filed complaint against me in Police Station,and filed maintenance petition in 2009 against me in court,matter of which is pending. After all reconcilation efforts,including even by Court appointed mediators failed,I sent her letter of First Talaq on 26th april 2010 written in my hand writing and duly signed by two witnessess through Speed Post at her Residence address in Delhi and sent scannned copy of letter also by email to her.On phone she acknowledged receipt of both these.Then I sent second letter of Talaq again on 29th May 2010 in my own hand writing and signed by same two witnesseses again by speed post and scaned copy by email.I had also mentioned in that the reference of first talaq and that it was the second one.I got Delivery Report of Speed Post.Then on 3rd July 2010,I sent the Final and third Talaq Letter to her in same manner in my hand writing and signed by same two witnesses.I also emailed scanned copy by email to her.In that letter too I had mentioned reference of earlier two talaqs and said it is the third and final one.Again I got receipt of acknowldegement and delivery report from her end.In that third letter I had also mentioned that I want to pay her Mehar amount of Rs.one lakh only by cheque /draft and I want her to meet me at a neutral place of conbvenience so that I can hand it to over to her. Kindly note that the court case is for providing maintenance for children only.It has nothing to do with talaq.This court case she had filed in May/June 2009 much before I sent her Talaq letter in April 2010.she had filed that maintenanace case under Section 125 saying that she had been thrown out of house and as she is living seperately she needs maintenanace from my end. NOW IN LIGHT OF ABOVE FACTS: I want to know whether this talaq is proper and valid or not? Still her mehar amount is due to be paid.I am willing to pay her the amount.I had mentioned that clearly to her in my final and third talaq letter.The Bank Draft of Rs.One lakh is ready in her name.But I want to pay her in presence of witneses only. I want to know that in between the period when the mehar is yet to be paid, is talaq complete or not? 1982 views Q. hanafi maslakh-talaq 6700 views Q. answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 31325 Country: United States of America Title: My husband had a fight with my mother in law. My mother in law is having a lot of complains about me. Question: My husband had a fight with my mother in law. My mother in law is having a lot of complains about me. In frustration my husband said this sentence to my mother in law on phone ""main abhi ees ko talaq day kay ghar say nikal daita honh"" My question is that is 1 talaq count or not? Thanks Answer ID: 31325 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 471/394/B=1432) This word is not of talaq, rather it is expression of readiness for giving talaq; hence no talaq took place with this sentence. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
